datasets.description: Zimbabwe Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/zimbabwe_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Zimbabwe to collect IPC classification data for different scenarios. The spatial classifications were compiled into geographic datasets (GeoJSON/KML) representing food insecurity phases by administrative area for medium-term projections throughout 2020.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
